## About the role

Acme Cloudworks builds fictional batch-computing tools for imaginary animation studios. The Nimbus Platform team operates the services that schedule and observe those workloads.

## Responsibilities

- Operate Linux services and participate in a shared incident-response rotation.
- Build Python automation for delivery, diagnostics, and service lifecycle tasks.
- Diagnose queue saturation, dependency failures, and database performance issues.
- Improve dashboards, runbooks, change reviews, and post-incident follow-up.
- Collaborate with product engineers and fictional studio integration teams.

## Required

- Three or more years operating production Linux services.
- Professional Python development experience.
- Experience delivering containerized services with Docker.
- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and HTTP APIs.
- Direct production experience with Quartz Scheduler.
- Ability to work from the Northbridge office three days each week.

## Preferred

- Kubernetes experience supporting platform services.
- Kubernetes experience improving deployment reliability.
- Kubernetes experience diagnosing cluster workloads.
- Experience with metrics and distributed queues.
- Familiarity with imaginary animation rendering workflows.
